name: dojo-fleet
description: See every subagent of a fan-out live, steer one mid-flight, and catch stalls by their writes, not their word.

stall_minutes.title: Stall after (minutes)
stall_minutes.description: A running agent is flagged stalled after this long with no tool call, a tool call that has not returned, or (for a writing agent) no file written. 0 turns stall checks off.

show_band.title: Band above the prompt
show_band.description: While agents run, show the fleet count above the prompt; when an agent's transcript is open, the band becomes its steering bar.

stall_toast.title: Toast on stall
stall_toast.description: Raise one toast when an agent first looks stalled.
